taunt: Learning? How… quaint. My Engine already knows everything, little lizard.
You *worked out* the answer? Yourself? Disgusting.
All that thinking. You'll wear your brain out, you know.
My champions never think. It saves SO much time.
Effort is obsolete, dear reptile. Do keep up.
Adorable. The dinosaur believes practice makes perfect. Perfect is PRE-INSTALLED.
gate_locked: This gate opens for thirty-eight Star Fossils. You have… fewer. Ha.
Still collecting? The Engine could simply TELL you where they are. Oh wait — no it couldn't.
Run along, little scholar. My citadel is not for the unqualified.
Knock knock. Who's there? Not you, for quite some time.
champion_lost: You freed another one? They were happier obedient. Probably. I never asked.
Fine. FINE. I have six more champions and INFINITE smugness.
That cog was expensive, you know.
praise_sarcastic: Oh, WELL DONE. Would you like a sticker?
Marvellous. A dinosaur that does long division. The end times.
Yes yes, very clever. My Engine is cleverer and it never gloats. Much.
Bravo. I am slow-clapping somewhere far away and very comfortable.
